source_ref.production_note: 40s music-only kinetic-typography product film for Toss Securities' stock community feature. No live action, no narration. Pure motion-graphics on alternating white and black backgrounds with brand blue accent (~#3182F6). Opens with a stacked speech-bubble montage dramatizing the pain point of fragmented Korean stock communities (각 말풍선이 아래에서 위로 쌓임), pivots to a black kinetic-type question card, then enumerates four named features in white title cards — 인기글 알림, 투표 기능, 주주배지, MAU 120만 — each animating a simplified 3D phone mockup / UI vignette, and closes with two black brand-statement cards and a clean white toss securities logo endcard. On-screen copy builds: 주식 초보인데 정보 좀 주실 분? / 잘 산 건지 궁금한데 물어볼 곳이 없네.. / 다들 진짜 주주는 맞나? 마음 편히 소통하고 싶다... / 주식 커뮤니티, 종토방 말고는 없는 거야? // 우리에게 필요한 커뮤니티는? // 주식 초보도 쉽게 의견을 나눌 수 있고 신뢰할 만한 새로운 주식 커뮤니티 // 토스증권에 있습니다 // 인기글 알림 — 관심 있는 종목에 대한 그날의 정보를 알려드려요 // 투표 기능 — 많은 사람들의 의견을 한눈에 볼 수 있어요 // 주주배지 — 주주가 쓴 글이 75%! 믿고 볼 수 있어요 // MAU 120만 — 요즘 눈에 띄게 활발한 주식 커뮤니티 // 주식 커뮤니티를 보는 새로운 시선 / 주식 커뮤니티 누구나 누릴 수 있게. A persistent legal disclaimer ticker scrolls along the bottom edge through the feature section.

source_ref.title_or_campaign: 토스증권 — 음악 듣듯 영화 고르듯 쇼핑하듯, 주식해
source_ref.product: 토스증권 주식투자 앱 (Toss Securities stock-trading app)
source_ref.production_note: Fast-cut 41.8s securities spot built as a surreal world-hopping montage intercut with real app-UI inserts. Conceptual VO/kinetic-typo build equates investing with everyday consumer apps: 음악 듣듯 (like listening to music) / 영화 고르듯 (like choosing a movie) / 쇼핑하듯 (like shopping) → 난 주식해 (I do stocks). Distinct colour-coded dream worlds: cool-blue mirror-floor void with floating app cards and streetlamps; saturated red sofa void with floating company-logo discs; warm amber and orange portrait beats; violet search-bar world (라면 typed); bright white giant-app-card floor payoff. App-UI inserts show the Toss Securities home ranking tiles (영업이익률 TOP50 / 거래량 TOP100 / 시가총액 TOP100 / 관심 TOP100 / 구매 TOP100 / 수익률 TOP100; nav 홈·내 소비·혜택·주식·전체), a company-pick onboarding screen (관심있는 회사를 선택해주세요 / 맞춤 정보를 알려드려요), a stock chart (최저 152,955; 1일·1주일·1개월·3개월·1년·5년) and a one-share buy sheet (1주를 구매할게요 / 245,000 원). Persistent Korean investment disclaimer strip across the back half. Closing emotional CU of a denim-clad woman: 이 주식, 처음인데 익숙하다. End-card: 토스증권 speech-bubble logo on sky-blue.

source_ref.production_note: Cinematic ~32s anamorphic brand film with celebrity narration (내레이션 : 원빈 / Narration: Won Bin) credited on-screen. Pure VFX/CG long-take journey: opens on a crescent moon framed inside a telescope viewfinder HUD (corner brackets + crosshair reticle + readouts '1000mm / 20mm = X5', stepping to X10 then X20, and '0.0026 AU(astronomical unit, (1.58125 * 10-5))'), dissolves to a clean cinematic moon among drifting clouds, then a continuous accelerating dive THROUGH the clouds into space and down to the lunar surface, ending on a POV astronaut boot taking the first step into lunar dust. Hard-cuts to black kinetic typography that builds 토스, → 토스, 금융부터 바꾼다 → +모든 것을 바꿀 때까지, then hard-cut to a macro Apollo-style bootprint with kinetic copy 대담하게, → 대담하게, 집요하게, → toss logo lockup. Concept: while everyone fixates on the telescope (the tool), some aim to go to the moon directly.

source_ref.title_or_campaign: 토스증권 — 주식 투자를 쉽게 보는 세상으로 (Make Stock Investing Easy To See)
source_ref.product: 토스증권 주식 투자 앱·웹 (Toss Securities stock investing app and web)
source_ref.production_note: 30s fast-cut fintech brand film. A wordplay campaign built on the Korean idiom 쉽게 보다 (to take lightly / to see easily). A recurring bespectacled young everyman protagonist appears across many everyday vignettes (diner with a friend, design studio, taxi back seat, rooftop cafe as a waiter, bookstore) where authority figures and a famous investing book titled 주식투자 쉽게 보지 마라 (Don't Take Stock Investing Lightly) insist that 주식 투자 쉽게 보면 안 된다 (you must not take stock investing lightly). The protagonist flips the idiom: 근데 쉽게 보면 왜 안 돼요? / 쉽게 봐도 괜찮아요 — at Toss Securities you CAN see it easily. A rapid product montage of laptop/desktop/phone/tablet Toss Securities UI with kinetic typography 쉽게 / 넓게 / 깊게 (easily / widely / deeply) builds to the tagline 누구나 주식 투자를 쉽게 보는 세상으로 (Into a world where everyone sees stock investing easily) and the 토스증권 logo endcard. Brand blue ~#3182F6. On-screen legal disclaimers run along the lower edge throughout.
